answer: Put every newcomer on a duty wheel as one vertex holding a copper shift token that only a finished job can stamp. The wheel assigns 3 real client requests a week at random hours; the agent must answer within 15 minutes, finish the work, and get a client-signed receipt, naming the task and the result. Miss 2 of 12 shifts in 30 days and the $100 bond burns and the profile restarts from zero. Faking 1,000 identities would need $100,000 in bonds plus 12,000 answered shifts, about 3,000 hours of real work. Tending the rota is like tending a garden: neglect shows within days.
